reviews.text: We just had Anthony Realtors sell our third house and once again they knocked it out of the park. Their presale prep helped us declutter and get our house in tip top shape. Their photography and drone work were superior. And their support all along the way made us feel completely comfortable and informed. I can’t recommend David and his team enough!!!

We had an excellent experience working with Dave Brough of Anthony REALTORS during our relocation from California to Fort Wayne, Indiana.

Purchasing a home from across the country comes with unique challenges, but Dave made the entire process much easier through his professionalism, responsiveness, patience, and thoughtful guidance.

He took the time to understand what mattered most to our family, provided valuable local knowledge, and helped us navigate property evaluations, inspections, negotiations, and closing arrangements with care and attention to detail.

What we appreciated most was Da
As a first time home buyer David was amazing and incredibly helpful with any questions I had. They were ready and available for anything I needed. I would absolutely recommend this company.

Dave Brough is an excellent, extremely knowledgeable, and professional Realtor! He helped us find our new house and handled every detail thoroughly. He now is going to get our “old” house on the market and feel confident that that will result in a successful sale!
I cannot thank David and his team at Anthony Realtors enough for the sale of my home. Great job!!!

I worked with Abbi on my daughter's house she was selling.  I appreciated being informed on the sale of her house every step of the way. This is the second time I have used Abbi and if the need every arises I need a realtor again it would be Abbi...thanks Abbi, we appreciate you !

Abbi and everyone I interacted with at Anthony Realtors was incredible. This is the second home we’ve purchased with Abbi, and I can’t imagine going through the process without her. She is endlessly patient and attentive, and nothing ever slips through the cracks. Buying a house can be stressful but Abbi and the team made everything as easy as possible!

We had such a great experience with Anthony Realtors and it’s the reason we keep coming back. We worked with Abbi to sell or current home and find a new home at the same time. Something that could be incredibly stressful felt so much easier with her help and guidance along the way. I can’t express how grateful we are and excited about this next chapter in our new home and we have Abbi to thank as well. She was so dedicated to helping us sell our current house and find a new one and we’re so grateful. If we find ourselves in the same position again, there’s no question that we’d go back to Abbi. W

I highly recommend Abbi to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, attentive, and dedicated professional. As a first-time homebuyer, I truly appreciated having someone who was so supportive and reassuring throughout the entire process. Abbi was always quick to respond to my questions and concerns, took the time to make sure I understood each step, and consistently kept my best interests in mind. She was an incredible advocate for me and went above and beyond to make what could have been an overwhelming experience feel smooth and manageable. I’m extremely grateful for her guidance, professionalism, a
I have worked with Abbi several times now as a buyer and seller 10/10 recommend. She is very patient and attentive and is truly focused on finding the best fit.

Everyone at Anthony made buying my first home such an easy quick experience. Abigail Oberley was my real estate agent anytime there was even a slight hick up her and her team resolved everything so quickly she made communicating with the seller extremely simple and resolved any and every question I had quickly and professionally. Great business to work with and amazing staff would absolutely recommend both Anthony Realators and Abigail Oberley.
Honestly dont think my experience could have been any more simple.

Had a flawless experience with Anthony Realtors. They had a great team and has the best realtor I know. They were fast and efficient while also being very flexible. No matter what problems I had or issues that needed to be addressed they help with everything and even got me contacted with other companies to make the whole process so smooth that I had to only worry about personal affairs. Thank you so much Anthony Realtors and thank you so much Ashley Collins Lamb for being the best to find our first home.
Ashley was great! She took her time with me in helping me find the perfect home for me and my family. Truly couldn’t have asked for a better realtor!!! Thank you so much

Ashley was from the moment we met her at an open house to the moment we walked into our now new home extremely knowledgeable, professional and experienced.
Even at the closing event she knew every single paper, its content and relevance.
She made us feel like we were her only client and followed up on questions and requests 24/7.
I would recommend her to any colleague, friend or family member and for me being a manager in a large German healthcare corporation, I would hire her in a heartbeat.
You have an extremely rare realtor working in your company, be proud that she chose you!

We would highly recommend Anthony Realtors and especially our agent Ashley. She was always available when we had a question and communicated often updating us on everything. We had a difficult close due to seller issues. Ashley put in many hours and went over and above to help us getthings done.  The office support were also there when we needed them. They were very prompt to answer on text and email.

I recently purchased a home through Anthony Realtors and the experience was as professional as you could imagine. The realtor , Ashley Collins , did an amazing job helping to facilitate the home viewing process , keeping me up to date with needed information & also communicating between the seller and I. Michelle Windenhoefer , the lender , helped make sure I was well knowledgeable about the home buying process , the criteria , and the responsibilities of being a first time homeowner. The process was smooth and upfront. Never any miscommunication , shady inspection business , or false advertisi

The whole team was an absolute pleasure to work with. Thr transaction was extremely smooth! I cannot say enough about Carla Holbrook, she is an absolutely brilliant realtor. I will highly recommend Carla and the Anthony team for your next home or property purchase or sale!!

Carla Holbrook was a really cool agent. She was on top of the whole deal throughout all the incidents that needed repairing. I would definitely have worked with her to get my next house if I didn’t move out of the state. She uses this awesome photographer and she sold my house in six days. I was amazed so let me just say that you should definitely try and get Carla for your agent whether you are buying or selling she does it all.

I'd like to thank Carla H. for all the work she did for us and how patient she was during the whole process. I usually ask lots of questions until things make sense in my personal language and having someone like her that was always there for us was awesome. Thanks to all the team, since the free seminars, my agent (Carla) and the whole team that made this dream come to reality

Carla Holbrook with Anthony Realtors was such a pleasure to work with! I enjoyed her company when we looked at houses and her honesty and I appreciate her kindness! She made me, my daughter and my husband feel at ease with our decision and now we are thrilled to be living in our home!! I would recommend Carla to anyone wishing to buy or sell a home!! Truly a wonderful woman!

Carla Holbrook went out of her way from start to finish to make sure I had everything I needed & was always there to answer questions & assist. If you need to buy or sell, I would highly recommend calling Carla!

Our relator, Elle, was AMAZING to work with! This was our second time buying a home, but our first time selling, and she made the entire process so smooth and stress-free. She was incredibly knowledgeable, responsive, patient, honest, and always had our best interests in mind. She went above and beyond for us, answered every question, kept us informed, and never made us feel pressured. We truly couldn’t have asked for a better realtor and are so thankful we had Elle by our side for both selling and buying our home! ❤️ Highly recommend her and the company she works with to anyone looking to buy o
Would one hundred percent recommend to anyone that is buying a home, I just closed on my first one and my realtor Elle helped me out through everything, amazing service
Great to deal with. Elle was amazing. She went above and beyond. Every went smoothly. Highly recommend

Elle was absolutely great to work with. She was very responsive, let us know every step of the way what was going on. Took the time to show us several houses until we found the one we wanted. I would highly recommend working with Elle if you're searching for your next or first home!

We had a great experience working with Jared Kent to sell our home. Our timeline was anything but certain. We were planning for a move out of state, and our own deadlines changed more than once along the way. Jared was incredibly patient through all of it. He checked in from time to time but was never pushy, and his message was always the same. He would be ready when we were ready.

Once we made the decision to move forward, Jared moved quickly. He walked us through the process, set clear expectations, and helped us think through the added challenge of moving out of state before our house was e
Jared Kent is the best!  He has guided me through 3 real estate transactions. I can’t imagine not having his guidance.

Jared was amazing.  So easy to work with and explains everything so well.
We would highly recommend him to anyone wishing to sell their home or to purchase a new one.

Jared was amazing. We had a long period of time from the sales agreement to closing and he kept us informed throughout the process, checking in appropriately and answering all of our questions along the way. His suggested sales price for our home was spot on. Highly recommend.

Challenges throughout the process of selling this condo did not deter Jared Kent from pushing through the frustrations and eventually landing a great buyer.  Highly recommend Jared for anyone selling a home in Allen County!!

Jason has now assisted in the purchase and sale of my first home. He was incredibly communicated throughout both processes. During the sale, he was a great advocate and truly felt like he was there to help me every step of the way.

Julia has come through again. She is such a wonderful person to work with and knows what she is doing. We have been fortunate to work with her before and she did not disappoint either time. It has been our privilege to know her and call her a friend.
Could not give a better recommendation for Julia Carsten as our realtor.

Julia was exceptional at helping my husband and I find our first home together. She was very communicative, honest, and always available when we needed her. With such a huge decision like buying a home, Julia made it incredibly clear and easy for us. We’re so glad Julia was with us through this process, her whole team was kind and helpful throughout the process. I’d recommend her to anyone!!
Julia was friendly, very professional and in communication with us the entire time. She went above and beyond. We recommend Julia Carsten she is the best real estate agent!

Julia was so easy to work with! She answered all of our questions quickly, and was always able to meet with us when we needed her. She made the process of buying a house easy and enjoyable. We loved working with everyone on her team. Her experience in the 07 helped us secure a house in a competitive market!

KeAire was my realtor, due to some unforeseen issues, this process took three years from the time I was initially contacted until today when I did my Closing, but I was continually followed up on asking me for updates, giving me updates and relevant information about the Ft Wayne market. KeAire is a true professional. I would recommend him to anyone interested in Northeast Indiana or Fort Wayne real estate questions
I had a good experience with Kearie Sander  and plan on working with him in the future.
KeArie is a professional, friendly, knowledgeable and accommodating to our needs. Highly recommend him.
Liz was a wonderful realtor. She kept us updated on the progress of the sale. She held open-houses and didn't shy away from spending a weekend opening it for potential buyers.

Working with Liz Smith and her team at Anthony Realtors was truly amazing. As active duty military, I was not able to be present for inspections or contractor consults, and Liz was there every step of the way to assist me. The team constantly provided me updates, even after business hours as information came to them, which I was not expecting. They made the process of finding and purchasing our dream home so easy. Thank you Liz Smith and Anthony Realtors!!!

Maddie was great to work with. She was prompt with all inquiries we had and very friendly. She also got me in touch with resources that I used and will be using for my move. We will be using her again in the future. Highly recommend!

Being out of town we needed Madeline to work closely with our daughter Vicki. She did a great job of communicating with me, Diana and Vicki starting with the first showing which was done while Diana and I were in town for less than 12 hours. We travelled for over a week starting the day after the showing and even though we were frequently out of cell service while hiking on our trip Madeline kept us advised of how our offer was progressing and she responded quickly to our questions and directives. There is no doubt that everything went smoothly and quickly thanks to Madeline's professionalism. W
Maddie was amazing! Great communication and made the process so much less stressful. Highly recommend!
Maddie was awesome! Extremely helpful and thorough. Very professional and easy to communicate with!

Couldn’t speak highly enough of Maddie Shine! She was professional, communicative, and truly on our side throughout the entire process. As first-time home buyers, we had a lot of questions, and she was always quick to help and provide whatever we needed along the way. We’d absolutely recommend her to anyone looking for a great realtor to guide them through the home-buying journey!
MonTe has done a great job assisting with my rental property purchase. He’s been patient and available to answer any questions that I have.

Working with MonTe and Anthony Realtors was a great experience. MonTe was always available when we had questions and communicated often updating us on everything. Made it easy from selling to buying, very knowledgeable and helpful along the way. Would definitely recommend their services.
MonTe is a great realtor!

As a first-time buyer, I had no clue what to do, but MonTe was patient, responsive, and guided us through every step. He was incredibly responsive, knowledgeable, very professional and made the entire process smooth and easy. He is on time as always and answering every text and any questions I had right away. I highly recommended Anthony Realtors. MonTe is the best! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We had the pleasure of working with realtor Monte Stevenson. He was extremely thorough and diligent in his process. He conducted an open house in freezing temperatures and located a buyer within the first week of our listing as well as insured that the closing went smoothly. Monty was very professional and we would highly recommend him to anyone!

Anthony realtors was amazing ryan handled everything perfectly always answered never had us waiting for anything and was able to deal with us and guide us when we where in a stressed time and frustrated making it a none stressed and or frustrating time with selling and buying at the same time i would 100 times over recommend Anthony realtors and Ryan that we worked with

We partnered with Anthony Realtors based on a referral, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience. Theresa Brough-Cavacini was our agent, and she exceeded every expectation. She answered all of our questions— even while on vacation— and guided us through each step with care. Her attention to detail and genuine commitment to making us a priority, not just a number, made the entire process smooth and stress-free. Highly recommend!

Theresa was amazing to work with. She was so patient as we looked for the perfect home for our family. Her knowledge and expertise was so helpful throughout the process of selling our home and purchasing our new home. Theresa is responsive, detail-oriented, thoughtful, and punctual.
